title: Asian-session (00-07 UTC) range breakout at the European open on 15m, 1R target, flat by 12:00 UTC
ex_ante_rule: Chart 15m, closed bars only, UTC clock; a signal at a bar close is filled at the next bar open. Long only, one position, whole allowed balance, no pyramiding. Runs every calendar day, weekends included. ASIAN RANGE for UTC day D: AH = highest high and AL = lowest low of the 28 bars of day D opening 00:00, 00:15, ..., 06:45 UTC. If any of these 28 bars is missing, day D is not armed. DAILY FILTER: ATR14 = ATR(14) with Wilder smoothing (RMA, alpha 1/14) of true range, computed on closed UTC daily candles (informative 1d via merge_informative_pair, only completed days, so the value used on day D is the one at the close of day D-1). Day D is ARMED only if 0.25 <= (AH - AL) / ATR14 <= 0.80. ENTRY WINDOW: the 12 bars of day D opening 07:00 through 09:45 UTC. Scan these bars in time order on their closes: if a bar closes below AL before any bar has closed above AH, there is no trade on day D (first break is downward). Otherwise, at the first bar in the window whose close > AH, buy at the next bar open (latest possible fill: the 10:00 open). At most one trade per UTC day; no re-entry that day after any exit. STOP: a price stop at AL, intrabar (fills as soon as the low touches AL; if a bar opens below AL, fill at the open), implemented with custom_stoploss as a fixed price level for the trade. Native fixed backstop stop-loss: 8% below entry price (intrabar), only a safety net since AL is always closer given the width filter on these pairs. TARGET: T = entry + (entry - AL), entry = actual fill price (1R); exit as a limit when a bar high reaches T, filled at T (if a bar opens at or above T, fill at that open). TIME EXIT: if neither stop nor target is hit, sell at the open of the 12:00 UTC bar of day D (exit signal on the close of the 11:45 bar). Longest hold about 5 hours, always under 24 hours. No cooldown beyond one trade per day. No other filters. Warm-up: 4320 bars (45 daily candles x 96 bars, generous for the recursive Wilder ATR(14); the intraday range needs at most 40 bars).
rationale: Hansen, Kim and Kimbrough (arXiv 2109.12142, summarised by Quantpedia) document strong hour-of-day periodicity in crypto volatility and volume on Binance: activity is lowest in the late East-Asian night and steps up as European participants arrive around 07-08 UTC. The 00-07 UTC range is therefore set in thin trading by passive liquidity; its high collects resting buy stops and breakout orders of range traders. When European flow arrives with a directional push, triggering those stops adds forced buying, so a close above AH is more likely to extend than a random intraday close. Counterparties: range sellers and short holders whose stops sit above AH, and passive overnight market makers whose stale quotes get run over. The width filter skips dead days (range < 0.25 ATR, no participation) and days where the daily move is already spent (range > 0.8 ATR). Costs: 1R is at least the range width, at least 0.25 x daily ATR; with daily ATR typically 3-6% on these pairs, the target is about 1-3% gross, well above the 0.30% base and 0.45% conservative round trip, and the stop is the same distance. Expected trades: about 365 days x roughly 40-55% armed x roughly 50% upward first break, i.e. about 70-150 trades per pair per year, near the low end of the owner's 150-500 target; this is stated honestly rather than loosened. Drawdown: losses are capped at 1R (about 1-3%), so a run of 10 losses stays near or below 25%. The source page states no reliable published win rate exists for these exact rules; this is FX session practice carried to crypto, and the edge is untested.
novelty_vs_tried: Closest is H-034 (SessionOpeningRangeBreakout): that used the single 00:00 1h candle as range, a fixed 0.8% minimum height, a midpoint exit, a 1.5x target, a 4% stop and a 20:00 exit, and it produced zero trades. H-067 uses a 7-hour Asian range (28 x 15m bars), a volatility-normalised width filter against closed-day ATR(14), a first-break-direction veto (no trade if price first closes below AL), a structural stop at AL with a symmetric 1R target, and a narrow 07:00-10:00 entry window tied to the European liquidity arrival with flat by 12:00. No other family in the lab trades the Asia-to-Europe session handover.

sources.title: Periodicity in Cryptocurrency Volatility and Liquidity (Hansen, Kim, Kimbrough, arXiv 2109.12142)
